stories.title: Justice Served or Political Payback? Jack Smith Faces Senate Grilling Over Trump Prosecutions
stories.conservative_headline: Jack Smith Squirms as Senators Expose His Partisan Witch Hunt Against Trump
stories.liberal_headline: Jack Smith Stands Firm as Republicans Launch Revenge Hearing Over Lawful Probes
stories.poll_question: Were the special counsel's Trump prosecutions legitimate?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Prosecutors weaponized DOJ to take down Trump before the election.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Smith followed evidence; no one is above the law.

stories.title: Cutting Waste or Breaking the Law? White House Claws Back $810 Million Congress Already Approved
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Axes $810 Million in Wasteful Health and Education Spending
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Illegally Seizes Power of the Purse, Gutting Health and Education Funds
stories.poll_question: Can a president cancel funding Congress already approved?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Presidents should stop spending on bloated, ineffective programs.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Only Congress controls spending; this is lawless impoundment.

stories.title: Border Security or Lethal Overreach? ICE Shootings Spark Lawsuits and New Use-of-Force Rules
stories.conservative_headline: Agents Under Siege: ICE Officers Defend Themselves as Activists Launch Lawfare
stories.liberal_headline: Families Sue After ICE Agents Shoot Civilians, Forcing Agency to Rewrite Rules
stories.poll_question: Are ICE agents using appropriate force?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Agents face violent resistance and deserve the benefit of the doubt.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Unaccountable agents are shooting civilians with no body cameras.

stories.title: Peace Through Strength or Endless Quagmire? Troops Leave Iraq as Iran War Death Toll Grows
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Brings Troops Home from Iraq After Crushing Iran's Military Threat
stories.liberal_headline: Pentagon Accused of Hiding True Death Toll as Iran War Drags Past Six Months
stories.poll_question: Is the administration handling the Iran conflict well?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Decisive force deterred Iran and let us bring troops home.
stories.poll_option2_desc: An undeclared war with undisclosed American casualties and no exit plan.

stories.title: Super Intelligence or Super Smokescreen? Trump Renames AI and Lets Companies Police Themselves
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Unleashes American Super Intelligence, Rejecting EU-Style Red Tape
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Hands AI Giants a Blank Check and a Rebrand Instead of Real Rules
stories.poll_option1_desc: Heavy regulation would hand the AI race to China.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Self-regulation is a giveaway to the richest companies on earth.

stories.title: Election Integrity or Voter Purge? Supreme Court Greenlights Citizenship Database for Voter Rolls
stories.conservative_headline: Supreme Court Hands Trump Win, Lets States Verify Citizenship of Voters
stories.liberal_headline: Supreme Court Opens Door to Purging Eligible Citizens Weeks Before Midterms
stories.poll_question: Should states use federal citizenship data to audit voter rolls?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Only citizens should vote; checking the rolls is common sense.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Flawed data will strip eligible Americans of their right to vote.

stories.title: Senior Relief or Election-Year Bribe? Trump Sends $90 Medicare Checks and Obamacare Refunds
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Delivers Direct Relief to Seniors Crushed by Healthcare Costs
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Dangles $90 Checks After Slashing the Health Programs Seniors Rely On
stories.poll_question: Are the new healthcare payments real relief?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Returning dollars directly to seniors beats bureaucratic middlemen.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Small checks can't offset massive cuts to health coverage.

stories.title: Accountability or Lawfare? Supreme Court Weighs Whether Oil Giants Can Be Sued for Climate Change
stories.conservative_headline: Justices Eye End to Blue-State Climate Lawfare Targeting American Energy
stories.liberal_headline: Big Oil Asks a Friendly Court to Kill Climate Suits as Alito Bows Out Over Stocks
stories.poll_question: Should energy companies face lawsuits over climate damage?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Courts shouldn't set energy policy through activist litigation.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Polluters who deceived the public should answer in court.

stories.title: Protecting Standards or Punishing Scholars? Visa Crackdown Freezes Columbia Journalism Admissions
stories.conservative_headline: Columbia Finally Faces Consequences for Years of Radicalism on Campus
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Visa Crackdown Shutters a Storied Journalism Program's Admissions
stories.poll_question: Are the administration's student visa restrictions justified?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Universities abused visas; tighter screening protects national interests.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Targeting journalism students is censorship dressed up as security.

stories.title: Hiring Freeze or Trump Slump? Economy Adds Just 29,000 Jobs as Unemployment Climbs
stories.conservative_headline: Labor Market Tightens as Trump Policies Reshape Hiring Ahead of Boom
stories.liberal_headline: Hiring Collapses to 29,000 as Wage Growth Hits a Five-Year Low
stories.poll_question: Who's responsible for the weakening job market?
stories.poll_option1_desc: High interest rates, not White House policy, are choking hiring.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Trump's agenda stalled hiring while paychecks lose to prices.
